si_display_and_preferences.raw_units: Dwell is SI seconds in hooks/repository; transition duration converts timestamp differences from milliseconds to seconds at display. Counts and returned percentages are dimensionless.
si_display_and_preferences.render_boundary: OperationalBrief receives numeric duration/count rawValue through useOperationalMetrics -> formatMetric. No source-unit conversion, deprecated converter or unit-suffixed field rewrite was made.
si_display_and_preferences.rounding: Page deliberately rounds whole minutes once then splits h/m; subminute display switches to seconds. The accepted 3599/7199-second rounding mechanism is retained.
si_display_and_preferences.locale: Percentages use subscribed useNumberFormatting; dates use explicit locale/timezone. Specialist duration interpolation bypasses locale, see TL-06.
si_display_and_preferences.sign_and_invalid: Raw finite negatives reach the custom duration formatter unless separately guarded; the custom formatter turns nonpositive duration into zero, see TL-07. This is conditional source-hardening evidence, not an observed bad server payload.
si_display_and_preferences.chart: Series use restrained chartTokens/semantic state identity, integer count axis and hidden-series stable keys. Fixed STATE_COLORS and theme light-dark colors are source-visible; saved palette choice effects require separate evidence.
si_display_and_preferences.not_applicable: Page has no distance/speed/energy/temperature/pressure/currency measurement to convert. Vehicle GUI units must not be used to reinterpret SI seconds.
si_display_and_preferences.preference_limits: Effective chart palette, density/font scaling, 12/24h settings, theme contrast and persistence were not exercised.

confirmed_findings.title: Exclusive end is applied inclusively by the vehicle-state repository
confirmed_findings.mechanism: Both hooks serialize endInstantExclusive as end, but timelineSelectSQL uses ts <= $3. Summary calls that same Timeline query. A transition exactly at the intended exclusive boundary is included in timeline/daily counts and can add a zero-dwell summary transition entry; adjacent windows can count the same boundary event.
confirmed_findings.owner: Narrow backend vehicle-state window-contract owner: internal\database\vehicle\states_repo.go plus directly covering repository/handler tests. Hook/handler contract review by API owner; no backend edits authorized here.
confirmed_findings.proposed_scope: Align this endpoint's upper-bound semantics with the existing workspace [start,endExclusive) contract; cover exact boundary and adjacent windows without changing unrelated APIs.
confirmed_findings.runtime_status: NOTRUN; source predicate and caller contract establish the mismatch.

confirmed_findings.title: Final transition dwell extends historical windows to wall-clock now
confirmed_findings.mechanism: The final in-window row always has next_ts=null, and transitionDuration uses Date.now rather than the requested exclusive end or an evidence-backed successor. For a past window the table/mobile/preview duration keeps extending after that window and can disagree with bounded summary suffix dwell. Absence of a successor inside a bounded query does not establish current state.
confirmed_findings.owner: Narrow TimelinePage duration owner, with directly covering TimelinePage tests.
confirmed_findings.proposed_scope: Make row-duration semantics explicitly requested-window/evidence bounded; preserve minute-rounding and all table/mobile/preview uses. Do not claim current-state duration from a bounded historical list.
confirmed_findings.runtime_status: NOTRUN; Date.now and missing successor construction are directly observed source.

confirmed_findings.title: Unavailable dwell evidence becomes zero-valued summary duration
confirmed_findings.mechanism: Array.isArray(by_state) alone makes summarySource available. Missing driving/charging/grouped state rows become 0 via ?? 0, and an empty by_state makes all dwell metrics show 0m. The repository returns []/0 when there are no in-window transitions, not a continuous zero-dwell observation; a null first from_state also leaves prefix coverage unknown. The page already labels observation completeness unknown, so array availability is insufficient evidence for per-state measured-zero dwell.
confirmed_findings.owner: Narrow TimelinePage summary-evidence adapter owner. An API owner may separately specify coverage/absence metadata; do not invent it in this page.
confirmed_findings.proposed_scope: Keep zero transition count for an authoritative empty transition list, but distinguish missing per-state dwell from explicit returned numeric zero. Preserve all four metrics and independent empty composition/list states.

confirmed_findings.title: Open transition preview is not bound to its originating vehicle/window
confirmed_findings.mechanism: previewTransition stores only a TransitionRow, not the originating vehicle/range/timezone. It is cleared only on close or replaced on inspect; no scope-change reset is present. A mounted workspace selection/range change therefore leaves old event fields visible while previewDay/recorded time use the new timezone and the Vehicle action uses the new vehicleId.
confirmed_findings.owner: Narrow TimelinePage preview-scope owner with directly covering page tests.
confirmed_findings.proposed_scope: Reset or explicitly bind retained preview evidence/actions to the originating scope on vehicle/window changes, using existing drawer and workspace ownership.
confirmed_findings.runtime_status: Interaction reproduction NOTRUN; incompatible state/prop dependencies are source-confirmed.

confirmed_findings.title: Daily transition classifications omit unknown states and under-disclose grouped states
confirmed_findings.mechanism: Only eight fixed destination strings increment the four daily buckets. Every other to_state leaves a day row with no increment, so returned unknown/new states remain in the transition table but are silently absent from daily counts. The displayed Sleeping series also includes offline, and Idle includes online/parked, without visible classification disclosure; the UTC subtitle describes time grouping only.
confirmed_findings.owner: Narrow TimelinePage daily-classification/disclosure owner; product/FSM owner decides authoritative group meaning.
confirmed_findings.proposed_scope: Retain raw transitions and existing series identities; make unclassified evidence visible and explain existing grouping instead of reclassifying offline as measured sleep. Do not silently change domain semantics.
confirmed_findings.runtime_status: Observed production state vocabulary NOTRUN; the fixed mapping and omission mechanism are confirmed source facts.

confirmed_findings.title: Specialist duration display bypasses effective numeric locale
confirmed_findings.mechanism: Duration formatters interpolate JS integers directly into h/m/s strings. Operational duration callbacks ignore the effective formatter preferences argument. Thus duration digits remain ordinary JS decimal text even when the number locale changes, while dates and percentages honor the subscribed locale.
confirmed_findings.owner: Narrow TimelinePage display adapter owner, reusing existing formatting/i18n owners rather than creating another formatter engine.
confirmed_findings.proposed_scope: Preserve once-only minute rounding and seconds thresholds while applying effective locale and agreed compact duration-unit labels at the display boundary.
confirmed_findings.runtime_status: Locale matrix NOTRUN; preference argument is demonstrably unused.

confirmed_findings.category: conditional malformed-source hardening, not observed production corruption
confirmed_findings.title: Finite negative dwell can be represented as a valid zero duration
confirmed_findings.mechanism: The page's custom duration formatter maps seconds <= 0 to 0m. Its display options use formatter but do not set durationStyle=roundedMinutes. The shared formatter rejects finite negative duration only for that named style before invoking a custom formatter, so a negative finite raw dwell can yield valueState=value with 0m; the time-by-state positive filter simultaneously drops the row. Healthy repository output clamps negatives, so this finding concerns the page's malformed-source handling rather than claiming bad persisted values exist.
confirmed_findings.owner: Narrow TimelinePage numeric-evidence validation owner; shared formatter contract owner only if a separately authorized cross-consumer change is needed.
confirmed_findings.proposed_scope: Keep explicit zero valid, preserve raw evidence and distinguish invalid negative dwell without hiding sections or weakening specialist rounding.
confirmed_findings.runtime_status: Malformed payload injection NOTRUN; conditional control-flow mechanism is source-confirmed.

confirmed_findings.title: Related evidence URLs are not self-contained selected-vehicle drillthroughs
confirmed_findings.mechanism: The five day-scoped related URLs serialize from/to and optional signals, but not vehicle_id. buildContextHref only serializes explicitly supplied keys, and EntityPreviewDrawer renders a plain router Link rather than preserveWorkspaceScope. The persisted selection may preserve same-session scope, but these URLs alone do not retain the originating selected vehicle when opened/bookmarked in another scope/session.
confirmed_findings.owner: Narrow TimelinePage related-link owner; destination-specific scope owners decide supported vehicle filters, particularly fleet-owned notification inbox.
confirmed_findings.proposed_scope: Serialize originating vehicle only where the existing destination contract supports it, preserve local-day drillthrough, and explicitly disclose fleet-wide destinations. Do not add duplicate selectors.
confirmed_findings.runtime_status: Bookmark/new-tab behavior NOTRUN; absent query context is source-confirmed, not a claim that every same-session click loses selection.
